correctness.rationale: Lemma 'centrally symmetric reflexive => width exactly 2' is mathematically correct. Lower bound: for primitive u, max_{P}<u,.> is attained at a lattice vertex hence integer; 0 interior => max>0 => max>=1; P=-P => min=-max => w_u=2*max>=2. Draft omits explicit integrality sentence but inference is valid and fillable. Upper bound: any reflexive facet has primitive normal u0 with max=1, symmetry gives min=-1 => w=2. Central-symmetry test 'V=-V as sets' is complete: reflexive unique interior lattice point is origin, any central symmetry must fix it so center is origin, and -Id permutes vertices. Computation replayed: parse yields 4319 entries; symmetry filter yields exactly the 13 claimed KS# (418,419,924,925,974,975,2310,2311,3056,3998,3999,4309,4310); per-class hull shows all facet distances c0=1, unique interior (0,0,0), two centroid-ordered determinant triangulations agree (8,48,16,24,32,12,12,36,20,16,28,20,24), first facet normal attains width 2, bounding-box lattice-point counts match table (7,27,11,15,19,9,9,21,13,11,17,13,15), dual-boundary enumeration gives w2-pairs (13,3,7,5,4,9,10,4,6,8,5,7,6) with all dual boundary points primitive and width-2. Verifier prints VERIFY_OK, reproduced independently. Draft correctly separates proved lemma vs computed census vs no conjecture. GL-distinctness relies on KS one-per-class plus pairwise-distinct invariant signatures (verified from table) and disclosed triple-correspondence check, honestly described as consistent rather than full canonical certification. No essential inference or boundary failure.

originality.rationale: No recorded prior states the headline census: complete direction-certified width table with sharp bound over the closed GL(3,Z)-family of centrally symmetric reflexive 3-polytopes. Nearest priors compared substantively: Kreuzer-Skarke hep-th/9805190 gives bare 4319 census with volumes/point counts but no widths, directions, or symmetric-family bound; Iriyeh-Shibata 1706.01749 proves symmetric Mahler product 32/3 in 3D, orthogonal (volume products, not widths); Blanco-Santos 1501.01055 classifies a different family (6-point polytopes: 74 width-2, two width-3) proving width classification is a recognized kind but on different scope; GRDB exposes bare invariants without widths. Live arXiv API queries confirm gap: Kreuzer-Skarke+width 0 hits, reflexive+lattice-width 0 hits, symmetric-reflexive+width 0 hits; centrally-symmetric+reflexive+polytope 7 hits (facet-number, edge-polytope, Weyl, Fano-graph papers) none with width census. Bare volumes do not imply widths. Lemma itself is elementary folklore from standard definitions (draft explicitly disclaims novelty for W*=2, claiming only census layer as new), but no verbatim prior for the 13-row certified census with attaining directions and dual-pair counts was found, so originality passes narrowly; triviality is scored under value, not originality.

value.rationale: Intrinsic low value: textbook restatement plus mechanical database slice, even though correct and new. The sharp bound W*=2 with gap 0 is a 3-line corollary of standard definitions requiring no census: any facet normal attains 2 and symmetry forces >=2. Runner-up gap 0 means no non-trivial flatness boundary; Blanco-Santos precedent is disanalogous (non-trivial 74/2 distribution requiring enumeration vs degenerate uniform 2 provable without enumeration). Census table adds no substantive invariant a future researcher needs to retrieve: normalized volumes and point counts are bare KS/GRDB invariants recomputed to identical numbers; attaining directions are trivial (any facet normal); w2-pair counts (dual boundary lattice points mod sign, 3..13) had no pre-existing demand, motivate no flatness/hollow/Ehrhart question, and support no downstream theorem — an unexplained enumeration. Motivation (flatness/hollow/Mahler programs) collapses because lemma alone settles the width question in seconds; the 13 KS numbers are obtainable by a seconds-long V=-V filter anyone with the public list can run. Exact-invariant protection does not apply because the value IS mechanically implied by definitions and certification alone (VERIFY_OK, two triangulations) does not rescue a trivial invariant per standard. No bounded addition (motivation paragraph, literature pointer) can make uniform trivial width non-trivial; defect is intrinsic, not presentational.
